source_corrections: Portfolio Greeks are signed sums with explicit quantities/multipliers, not automatically normalized averages.
Same-stock same-expiry vanilla gamma and vega are proportional under common volatility; arbitrary simultaneous targeting may lack rank.
Gamma and vega maxima as stock varies need not occur exactly at strike; vega need not increase monotonically over arbitrary maturities.
Positive vega follows exact formula, not a generally monotonic d1 in volatility.
Long arbitrary derivatives need not have positive gamma/vega.
The source3200 is a partial stock-leg realized gain; full financed book P&L needs option revaluation/time/carry.
Empirical spot-volatility scenario is conditional and is not an investment recommendation.
Forward quote derivative is not existing fixed-strike forward value delta; corrected source foreign notional is6485372.73143405.
